tagline.en: A Malaysian number, passport sign-up, roaming packs for China
tagline.zh: 马来西亚原生号码，护照实名，有回国流量包

description.en: Hotlink is the prepaid brand of Maxis Berhad, Malaysia's largest mobile operator (launched 1999, own network — not an MVNO). Get the eSIM in-app for RM5 with passport KYC and a Malaysian address, top up RM20+ for signal, then buy roaming packs for China (e.g. RM100/40GB/30 days). Best keep-alive (per app): RM30 for 180 days with 30GB — about RM60/year. WhatsApp registration verified; Google SMS verification failed in testing. Official roaming quotas conflict and keep-alive pricing is historical; see the verification note below.
description.zh: Hotlink是马来西亚最大移动运营商Maxis Berhad（明讯）旗下的预付费品牌（1999年推出，自有网络非虚商）。App内护照实名+马来地址即可RM5开通eSIM，充值20RM以上来信号，再购买中国漫游包（如RM100/40GB/30天）。最划算保号（App内口径）：RM30得180天有效期+30GB流量，年保号约RM60。实测注册WhatsApp成功；Google账号短信验证失败。 漫游额度有官方来源差异，保号价格为历史实测，详见本页核验说明。

details.en:
Hotlink is the quality route to a native Malaysian +60 number: Maxis's own network (fast and stable in cities), full in-app onboarding, and roaming packs that actually work in mainland China — a 1-day 1GB pack tested at a genuine Malaysian IP (Maxis network) with Speedtest at 58.59 Mbps, fine for video or streaming.

Acquisition (2026-01 source review): install the Hotlink app on a native-eSIM phone (eSIM chips like Xesim/9eSIM are NOT supported), choose 'Activate or Get New SIM' → eSIM → RM5 plan → passport photo KYC → pick a number → enter email plus a Malaysian address found on Google Maps → pay by Visa/Mastercard. Key trap: after download the eSIM shows NO signal until you top up at least RM20 — smaller top-ups leave it dead, and it looks like failed activation.

Second trap: do NOT turn on data roaming before buying a roaming pack — base roaming rates silently burn your balance.

Roaming packs live under Home → Roaming → China: the value pick is 30 days / 40GB / RM100 (confirmed on the official roaming page 2026-09, now under the 'Over 100 countries' family; China also sits in the Asia+Pacific RM55/7d/15GB list). Per the current official single-country sheet, 1-day passes price at RM10 (ASEAN) / RM38 (other countries — China is in the RM38 tier); the earlier RM20/1GB/1-day China test pack no longer appears on the public price sheet.

Keep-alive: plain top-ups are poor value (RM10 = +30 days, RM5 = +5 days, ~RM120/year); the smart route is the 180-day 30GB pass at RM30 — about RM60/year (local validity passes are app-only and were not re-verifiable on public web pages as of 2026-09). A legendary RM30/365-day no-data pass has been delisted and no longer appears in-app.

Registration reality check: WhatsApp signup worked; Google account SMS verification failed even with balance — the source suspects the bundle only covers ordinary domestic P2P SMS, not short-code or international destinations. Passport KYC is mandatory.

Checked 2026-11-20 against official roaming, comparison and linked roaming-pass T&C pages. Product and comparison pages advertise RM100/30d/40GB, but the linked T&C (version 12 June 2023) still lists 25GB. These first-party sources disagree: confirm the actual quota and country list in the app before paying. The current FAQ lists destination-dependent RM10/RM20/RM38 one-day prices, not a universally verified China price. RM30/180d keep-alive, RM5 onboarding and RM20 activation-balance statements remain 2026-01 source-test observations, not fresh tariff verification. Sources: [official roaming](https://www.hotlink.com.my/en/services/international-roaming/) ; [official comparison]([official roaming](https://www.hotlink.com.my/en/services/international-roaming/)compare/) ; [roaming terms](https://www.hotlink.com.my/en/terms-conditions/services/roaming-pass/)
details.zh:
Hotlink是获取马来西亚原生+60号码的品质路线：Maxis自有网络（城市快且稳）、全流程App内办理、中国大陆漫游包真实可用——实测1天1GB包为真马来西亚IP（Maxis网络），Speedtest 58.59Mbps，看视频直播没问题。获取流程（2026-01源测评）：原生eSIM手机装Hotlink App（不支持Xesim/9esim等eSIM芯片卡）→「Activate or Get New SIM」→eSIM→RM5套餐→拍护照实名→选号→填邮箱+Google地图上找的马来西亚地址→Visa/Mastercard支付。

关键坑一：eSIM下载后无余额无信号，须充值至少20RM才有信号，充少了照样无服务，别误以为激活失败。

关键坑二：买漫游包之前千万别开数据漫游，基础漫游资费会静默扣掉余额。

漫游包在App主页Roaming→China：性价比之选是30天40GB RM100（2026-09官方漫游页确认，现归入「Over 100 countries」档；中国也在亚太区 RM55/7天/15GB 名单内）。按现行官方单国价表，1天包为 RM10（东盟）/ RM38（其他国家——中国属RM38档）；此前的1天1GB RM20中国测试包已不在公开价表。

保号：纯充值不划算（RM10加30天、RM5加5天，一年约RM120）；聪明路线是RM30的180天30GB套餐，年保号约RM60（本地有效期套餐仅App内可见，2026-09公开网页无法复核）。曾经的RM30保一年（无流量）神套餐已下架，App内找不到了。

注册实测：WhatsApp注册成功；Google账号短信验证失败（充值后仍发不出），源推测套餐只含普通国内点对点短信、不含短号或国际短信。护照实名强制。

2026-11-20对照官方漫游页、对比页及其链接的漫游条款复核：产品页和对比页列RM100/30天/40GB，但条款（标注2023-06-12版本）仍列25GB，两个一手来源存在差异，购买前以App实际额度与国家名单确认。当前FAQ的一天包为按目的地RM10/RM20/RM38，不能据此断言中国统一RM38。RM30/180天保号、RM5开通及充值RM20后有信号均为2026-01源实测，未完成现行复验。来源：[官方漫游页](https://www.hotlink.com.my/en/services/international-roaming/) 、[官方对比页]([官方漫游页](https://www.hotlink.com.my/en/services/international-roaming/)compare/) 、[漫游条款](https://www.hotlink.com.my/en/terms-conditions/services/roaming-pass/)

note.en: Hotlink is Maxis' prepaid brand; its data IPs sit in Maxis Broadband Sdn Bhd ranges (AS132434/AS9534, e.g. 113.211.x.x, 121.120.x.x) registered in Malaysia and typed as mobile carrier, not datacenter. Mobile-proxy vendors source real Malaysian Maxis IPs from these ranges.
note.zh: Hotlink 为 Maxis 旗下预付品牌，出口 IP 属 Maxis Broadband Sdn Bhd 网段（AS132434/AS9534，如 113.211.x.x、121.120.x.x），注册地马来西亚、性质为移动运营商 IP 而非机房；移动代理商用其网段提供真马来西亚 IP。
